name: Coercion
source:
You play as a college guy trying to pass his last semester... but all the women in his life are making it hell!

You make a few decisions, find out a few secrets and take advantage where you can.
translation:
你扮演一名大学生，试图度过最后一个学期……但他生命中的所有女人都让他的生活变得地狱！

你做出一些决定，找出一些秘密，并尽可能地利用。
